name: @forge-dev/mod-monoku-os
description: What Monoku OS expects from you, read by a headless agent

account.label: CW account
account.help: The account whose Claude has the Monoku OS connector

when.label: When to read
when.help: on-open: when you look at Forge and the last reading is older than the minutes below; interval: every N minutes; daily: once a day; manual: only with Read now

every.label: Minutes
every.help: on-open: how old a reading may be; interval: how often to read

projects.label: Projects
projects.help: Which CW project each Monoku OS project opens in; a project may have several rows, one per repo. Without a row, the CW project whose git origin is the repository Monoku OS lists is used
